name: Amerant Bancorp Inc.
summary: Amerant Bancorp Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Amerant Bank, N.A. that provides banking products and services to individuals and businesses in the United States. The company offers checking, savings, business, and money market accounts; cash management services; and certificates of deposit. It also provides variable and fixed rate commercial real estate loans; owner-occupied; single-family residential; commercial; and Loans to financial institutions and acceptances, and consumer loans and overdrafts, such as automobile, personal, or loans secured by cash or securities and revolving credit card agreements.
